Thanks, Tessa — I reviewed the Redlined_MSA and the Order Form. High level: most of HealthSys's edits are acceptable, but there are three items that need reconciling before we can sign: 

1) Data retention clause (Section 7): HealthSys's proposed 5-year retention is broader than our standard 24-month operational logs; propose carving out audit logs to 5 years while keeping model usage telemetry to 24 months.
2) Indemnity/limitation language: HealthSys added tighter indemnity language in the Order Form. We can accept narrower scope with a higher cap if procurement is comfortable — I'll propose alternate wording in the attached annotated MSA.
3) Insurance: we need a carrier + limits on the PO. Please provide your standard certificate or confirm you'll accept the template attached.

I've attached an annotated PDF (Redlined_MSA_HealthSys_20260620.pdf) and a redline of Annex A (OrderForm_AnnexA_20260620.docx) with in-line comments. If HealthSys accepts the edits I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope for execution.

Suggested next steps for the portal team:
- Mateo: confirm whether Coupa will accept the field "vendor_tax_id" vs "tax_id" (we can map either, just need the attribute name).
- Marissa: finalize the vendor metadata checklist and confirm fields required for SSO and EDI setup.

If anyone wants to talk through the indemnity cap numbers, I'm free Wednesday 10–11am PT.

Attachments: Redlined_MSA_HealthSys_20260620.pdf; OrderForm_AnnexA_20260620.docx; Insurance_Certificate_Template.pdf

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
